questions.question: When Mordecai learned about the decree to destroy all the Jews, what did he do?

answers.text: He tore his clothes and put on sackcloth
He went straight to Haman's house to argue
He locked himself inside his home to hide

questions.question: In Queen Esther's day, what was the law for anyone who approached the king in the inner court without being summoned?

answers.text: They were sent out of Susa

questions.question: Mordecai urged Queen Esther to plead for her people. What did he ask her to consider about her being queen?

answers.text: Maybe she became queen for this very moment
Maybe the king never really trusted her
Maybe she was never meant to be queen

questions.question: Before going to the king, Queen Esther asked Mordecai to gather the Jews in Susa. What did she ask them to do for her?

answers.text: Fast for her for three days
Write a plea to the king
